tasks.title: Web Push Notification Engine for Real‑time Guest/Host Alerts
tasks.description: Implement a fullstack push notification system. Add a new SQLite table `push_subscriptions` with columns `id`, `userId`, `endpoint`, `keysP`, `keysAuth`. Create `src/lib/pushNotificationEngine.js` exposing `saveSubscription(userId, subscription)`, `removeSubscription(userId)`, and `sendNotification(userId, payload)` using the `web-push` library with VAPID keys. Extend `server.js` with two REST endpoints: POST /api/notifications/subscribe (auth‑protected, stores subscription) and POST /api/notifications/unsubscribe (removes subscription). Update booking and chat logic (e.g., after `insertMessage` and after `insertBooking` status change) to call `sendNotification` with appropriate payloads. On the frontend, add `src/components/PushNotificationProvider.jsx` that registers a service worker (`src/service-worker.js`), requests Notification permission, and posts the subscription to the backend. The service worker listens for `push` events and displays a notification with title/body from the payload. Update `App.jsx` to wrap the app with `<PushNotificationProvider>` and display a UI toggle in the user settings menu.
acceptance: A logged‑in user can enable notifications in the UI, the browser shows the permission prompt, and the subscription is persisted in the SQLite `push_subscriptions` table.
When a new chat message is inserted for that user, a push notification appears on the device even if the browser tab is closed.

Create a new library module `src/lib/mapEngine.js` that computes geohash clusters and aggregates listing counts. Extend `src/lib/db.js` with a helper `getListingsInBBox(minLng, minLat, maxLng, maxLat)` that uses an indexed SQLite R-Tree for fast spatial queries. Update the frontend `src/components/MapView.jsx` to request clustered data, and add a new component `src/components/MapCluster.jsx` that renders cluster markers (showing count) and individual listing markers when zoomed in. Rejecting a request updates the status to `rejected`, stores the host's optional message, and notifies the guest via push notification.

tasks.title: Automated Payment Fraud Detection Engine
tasks.description: Create a fraud detection module that evaluates each payment request before it is sent to iyzico. Add a new `fraud_score` column to the `payments` table, implement `src/lib/fraudEngine.js` with rule‑based checks (e.g., velocity, mismatched IP/geo, blacklisted cards) and a simple ML scoring stub. Extend `src/lib/iyzicoEngine.js` to call `calculateFraudScore` during `processDirectPayment`, store the score in the DB, and abort the transaction if the score exceeds a configurable threshold (default 80). Update GraphQL resolvers to expose `fraudScore` on the `Payment` type and add a new `paymentFraudCheck` mutation for manual re‑evaluation. Ensure all new code is covered by unit tests and that the existing payment flow remains unchanged for low‑risk scores.
acceptance: A new column `fraud_score` exists in the `payments` table and is populated on every payment insert.
Payments with a fraud score > 80 are rejected and the API returns a `FraudDetected` error message.
The GraphQL schema includes `fraudScore` on the `Payment` type and the `paymentFraudCheck` mutation works as expected.
Unit tests in `src/lib/__tests__/fraudEngine.test.js` pass with >90% coverage.
No regression in existing payment processing tests.

tasks.title: Secure Photo Upload with Virus Scanning and Image Optimization
tasks.description: Add a new multipart/form-data endpoint (/api/listings/:id/photos) in server.js that uses multer for file handling. Pipe each uploaded file through a ClamAV scan (via node-clam) and reject the request if a virus is detected. On successful scan, process the image with sharp to create a 200x200 thumbnail and a web‑optimized JPEG (quality 80). Store the original and thumbnail in a public/uploads directory and record their URLs in the listings table (new columns photoUrl and thumbnailUrl). Expose a helper in src/lib/photoUpload.js for the upload, scan, and resize pipeline. Create a React component src/components/PhotoUpload.jsx that allows drag‑and‑drop or file‑picker selection, shows preview thumbnails, validates file type/size client‑side, and calls the new endpoint via fetch with the auth token. Update the HostDashboard and ListingDetail pages to include this component for creating/editing listings.
acceptance: Uploading a valid JPEG/PNG results in a new DB row with photoUrl and thumbnailUrl, files saved on disk, and the UI displays the thumbnail preview.
Uploading a file that fails the ClamAV scan returns a 400 response with an error message, no files are stored, and the DB is unchanged.
The PhotoUpload component rejects files >5 MB or non‑image MIME types before sending, and shows an appropriate validation message.

tasks.description: Introduce optional time‑based one‑time password (TOTP) MFA. Add a new DB column `mfaEnabled` and `mfaSecret` to the users table. All existing non‑MFA login flows remain unchanged.
